error.message: placement_policy "any-24gb" was stamped on this attempt but the loaded catalog no longer defines it; a later catalog pull request folded it into prefer-warm-local. Policies are catalog data, so they appear and disappear by pull request against the ConfigMap while this contract's enum lags by one merge - that window is exactly what this error covers. A policy name outside the contract vocabulary is a different failure: PlaceRequest.placement_policy is a closed enum, so it is rejected 400 invalid_request before any catalog lookup happens.
